Name: Shie's style portraits for Mirren the Florist
Author: Lucidia611
Description:
A portrait mod in[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264] Shie's portrait[/url] art style for the custom npc [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39733]Mirren the Florist by SpecialAgentJonson[/url].

For anyone who also uses Shie's portraits... I love their art style ﻿so decided to give a take on Mirren - a very intriguing character who wreaked havoc on my psyche last month. Currently the mod only consists the replacement for Mirren's Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter (indoor and outdoor), and beach outfits. I may or may not finish the rest of his festival outfits later on.

The mod [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url] are required for the portraits to show up. Simply place all the png assets from this mod into your portraiture's portraits folder.

Downloads.Description: RENAMED PNG ASSETS, it should work now
